integration_issues.issue: After a full-page reload / direct URL entry on /research, the initial useEffect Promise.all rejects with 401 ('Missing token') from /api/ai/models + /api/chats even though /api/billing/usage succeeds on the same page (CreditsBadge renders '300' credits). Root cause is that the Promise.all uses no .catch on models/chats — a single 401 crashes the whole init, so models[] stays empty and comparisonAllowed defaults to true, which hides research-upgrade-banner. This is NOT an iter135 bug — it existed before and is only triggered by page reloads (normal in-app navigation preserves the token). Suggest wrapping each apiGet in .catch(() => null) like the usage call does.

Not blocking iter135.
(Nice-to-have) Add an admin/dev endpoint to zero out extra_credits so IAP regression tests can teardown without direct Mongo access.
critical_code_review_comments: services/iap_revenuecat.py L163-172 handle_event: NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE uses txn_key = f"{store}:{tid}" where tid = e.get('transaction_id') OR e.get('id'). If a badly-formed event has neither, tid=None and txn_key='store:None' — the first such event would grant credits and any subsequent NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE with a missing transaction_id would be deduped as a 'replay'. Consider rejecting when transaction_id is empty.

services/iap_revenuecat.py L83-87 _target_workspace uses iap_workspace_id||workspace_id. If a user switched active workspace between opening the paywall (which called /iap/register) and the webhook arriving, credits are applied to the OLDER workspace — that's actually the correct product behavior (the purchase belongs to the workspace they intended). Just document.
routes/iap.py L60-66 dedupe uses upsert on rc_events.event_id then checks upserted_id. Race-safe. Good.

routes/iap.py L46 uses `if not iap.is_configured()` before checking Authorization — this hides the 401 behind a 503 if RC_WEBHOOK_AUTH is ever emptied. Currently RC_WEBHOOK_AUTH is set, so behavior is correct.

mobile/app/paywall.tsx L84-89 manage() uses Platform.OS ternary. On web (Platform.OS==='web') it falls through to the else — but the manage button is only shown when iapAvailable() (native), so it's never reachable on web. Not a bug, just dead path on web.

mobile/app/paywall.tsx: the paywall-open-web button on the unavailable card opens teamnest.ai/billing via Linking — this is INTENTIONAL and compliant (the note is a manual user tap after they landed on the mobile paywall in the web preview; on native Android the discount card is separate, on iOS this unavailable card never shows because IAP is available).
